name: Max Kelly
biography: is a recognized thought leader in the security space. As CSO of Facebook, he founded, built, and managed the Facebook Security Team from 2005-1010. He was responsible for all aspects of Facebook Security, protecting hundreds of millions of users personal information from attack. His prior experience includes FBI, Ticketmaster, and Thomson Financial Services. Max is a co-founder of the Virtuosi Group, providers of targeted threat intelligence and analysis.
